Pendaftaran Pemain BaruNew Player Registration

Ready to Join the Team?

Mulai perjalanan sepak bola bersama GarudaKids FC. Isi formulir di bawah, lalu lanjutkan konfirmasi melalui WhatsApp.Start your football journey with GarudaKids FC. Complete the form below, then continue the confirmation via WhatsApp.

Data tersimpan di perangkat Anda.Your details are ready.

Jendela WhatsApp seharusnya terbuka otomatis. Jika tidak,A WhatsApp window should have opened. If not, lanjutkan via WhatsApp di sinicontinue via WhatsApp here.

Formulir PendaftaranRegistration Form

Kolom bertanda * wajib diisi.Fields marked * are required.

Jangan mengisi data medis rinci di sini. Sampaikan langsung ke pelatih saat observasi.Please avoid detailed medical data here. Share it directly with the coach at the observation session.

Menekan tombol di atas akan membuka WhatsApp berisi ringkasan data Anda. Tidak ada data yang dikirim ke server pihak ketiga.Submitting opens WhatsApp with a summary of your details. No data is sent to any third-party server.

Alur PendaftaranHow Registration Works

  1. 1. Isi formulir1. Complete the form — data dasar pemain dan orang tua.basic player and parent details.
  2. 2. Konfirmasi WhatsApp2. WhatsApp confirmation — tim kami membalas dengan jadwal observasi.our team replies with an observation slot.
  3. 3. Sesi observasi3. Observation session — pemain mengikuti satu sesi latihan.the player joins one training session.
  4. 4. Penempatan kelompok4. Group placement — berdasarkan usia dan hasil observasi.based on age and observation results.
  5. 5. Mulai latihan5. Start training — jadwal dan grup WhatsApp kelompok diberikan.schedule and group WhatsApp channel are shared.

Yang Perlu DisiapkanWhat to Prepare

  • Sepatu bola dan pelindung tulang keringFootball boots and shin guards
  • Botol minum pribadiPersonal water bottle
  • Kartu identitas anak (untuk verifikasi usia)Child ID (for age verification)

Informasi biaya dikonfirmasi via WhatsApp karena berbeda per kelompok dan periode pendaftaran.Fee information is confirmed via WhatsApp as it differs by group and registration period.

Perlindungan data anak. Nama pemain ditampilkan dalam bentuk singkat dan tanpa informasi sensitif. GarudaKids FC tidak menampilkan alamat rumah, alamat sekolah, tanggal lahir lengkap, kontak pribadi orang tua, maupun data medis pemain di halaman publik.Child data protection. Player names are shown in abbreviated form without sensitive details. GarudaKids FC does not publish home or school addresses, full dates of birth, parents' private contacts, or medical information on public pages.

GarudaKids FC Pembinaan Sepak Bola Usia MudaYouth Football Development

Akademi sepak bola usia muda di Sidoarjo, Jawa Timur. GarudaKids FC membina pemain muda melalui pelatihan profesional, program terstruktur, disiplin, kerja sama tim, dan pengalaman kompetitif.A youth football academy in Sidoarjo, East Java. GarudaKids FC develops young players through professional coaching, structured training, teamwork, discipline, and competitive experience.
